title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/44.1k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience capture of a blistering show, highlighted by a smoking Wheel > The Other One > Truckin' sequence.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the vivid, first‑person audience recording that transports listeners back to the night, calling it "devastating" and "amazing." The performance itself is described as blistering with a standout Wheel → Other One → Truckin' medley (and even an all‑time favorite Althea), delivering high energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 4–5 stars, consistently praising both the show’s energy and the audience recording’s fidelity; no negative comments were found.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vivid, immersive capture that many reviewers say even surpasses soundboard recordings for authenticity; no major glitches or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows powerfully, with the Wheel > Other One > Truckin' sequence highlighted as a peak moment; overall pacing is described as high‑energy and engaging.
